description: This file defines the UpdatePasswordController class within the OrangeHRM project, responsible for managing the password update functionality in the user interface. It extends an abstract Vue controller and sets up a Vue component with a username property for rendering an update password view.

classes.name: UpdatePasswordController
classes.description: Controller responsible for handling password update views, preparing a Vue component with the current user's username as a property.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the Vue component before rendering, setting up a component with the current user's username as a property.
